evidence_policy: PROVEN for byte/PE facts; UNKNOWN for untraced behavior

findings.text: WCC and WBB counterparts have identical import lists, named export lists, export counts, and file sizes for MMUD, MMPLS, and MMUTL.

All observed pair differences are confined to embedded distribution identity strings and single-character path/name substitutions; no differing executable instruction bytes were identified by the range classification.
WCC/WBB are packaging identities over a shared ABI, but exact hashes remain required for provenance.
Host function implementation semantics remain unavailable without WGSERVER.EXE and its matching runtime libraries.
